request.spec: Let me filter projects by active, on hold or finished.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read CLAUDE.md — it states the working rules, the project layout, and the data-testid
conventions. Follow it.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Let me filter projects by active, on hold or finished.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, and any audit records it
expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as you work;
iterate until it passes. Implement the full-stack change (database migration + OfficeFloor
server + front-end). Do NOT edit the pinned scaffolding (bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop,
bin/e2e, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md) or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The test passes. 

The change was small because the backend already supported project status (V19 migration, `ListProjects` returning `status`, seed support in `TestSupportController`, and the UI already rendered `project-status`). The only missing piece was the filter control itself, which I added to the projects feature:

- A `project-status-filter` `<select>` (All / Active / On hold / Finished), composed alongside the existing tag filter.
- `statusFilter` state and a client-side filter step that narrows the visible rows to the chosen status, layered after the existing archived/tag filtering so all filters compose.

No backend, schema, or shared-surface changes were needed, keeping the change additive and local to the projects feature.
